from pathlib import Path
import os,subprocess,json,time,datetime
r=Path('/home/claude/code/EKA2L1-sky-performance');s=Path('/home/claude/.scratch/eka-sky-performance')
for route,start in [('standard',21000000),('long',42000000)]:
 env={k:v for k,v in os.environ.items()if not k.startswith('EKA2L1_')}
 env.update(EKA2L1_WASM_BUILD_DIR=str(s/'candidate-bridge-v8'),EKA2L1_BENCHMARK_AOT='5',EKA2L1_AOT_IR_MODE='7',EKA2L1_AOT_EAGER_REGIONS='0',EKA2L1_THUMB_MEMORY='1',EKA2L1_TLB_HASH='1',EKA2L1_CODE_COMPARE='2',EKA2L1_CODE_LOOKUP='0',EKA2L1_PREDICATED_LEAVES='1',EKA2L1_LEAF_FEATURES='128',EKA2L1_UNSAFE_CODE='3',EKA2L1_SHARED_AUDIO='1',EKA2L1_GPU='hardware',EKA2L1_PROFILE_DETAIL='1',EKA2L1_GUEST_PROFILE='997',EKA2L1_EXECUTION_LIMITS='512,16,8,512',EKA2L1_PROFILE_START_US=str(start),EKA2L1_PROFILE_INPUT=str(r/('src/tests/benchmark/snakes.input'if route=='standard'else'src/tests/benchmark/snakes-length-long.input')))
 name=f'v8-current-census-{route}'
 args=['node','profile.ts','/home/claude/.scratch/eka-benchmark/assets',str(s/name),'1','0',str(start+18000000)]
 (s/(name+'-command.json')).write_text(json.dumps({'args':args,'env':{k:v for k,v in env.items()if k.startswith('EKA2L1_')},'head_at_run':subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],cwd=r,text=True).strip(),'diagnostic_only':True,'started':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()},indent=2))
 print(name+' START',flush=True)
 with(s/(name+'.log')).open('w')as f:subprocess.run(args,cwd=r/'src/tests/wasm',env=env,stdout=f,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,check=True,timeout=1800)
 print(name+' DONE',flush=True)
(s/'v8-snakes-census-complete.json').write_text(json.dumps({'completed':2}))
